bidness.jpeg.caption: Sometimes you just gotta suit up and do what has to be done.

dunnkicks.jpeg.caption: My little brother died from fentanyl but man was he ever AG — these belong to him.

dunnsintree.jpeg.caption: Every day I miss the shit out of my little brother. This was a fond memory — him and I when we were really young, hanging from a tree in the woods behind my parents house.

floatingpoi.jpeg.caption: Sometimes you gotta spin poi — but not just anywhere. Might as well do it on a floating mattress in the middle of Lake Dillon.

fulllotus.jpeg.caption: People are impressed when they see this and to me it's really no big deal. All you gotta do is do yoga every day for a year and next thing you know you're flexible. At least that's how it was for me — I was not born flexible.

intree.jpeg.caption: I am an absolute tree man and I love Live Oak trees over freshwater. It's a special thing about being in Florida — the live oaks — and oh how I love them.

Mechmatt.jpeg.caption: Developing the skills of mechanical inclination will always serve you well in this world.

pads.jpeg.caption: As I got older I realized how important it is to protect my body. It wasn't until the 3rd decade of my life that I decided I really need full pads and a helmet — and to this day I wear them at the skate park and I'm still cool.

Selfyfromtehfort.jpeg.caption: When my little brother died I didn't leave this mattress in front of the TV where I just vegged out on video games for weeks in sadness. Then I got up, tried to breathe, and decided to take a selfie. This is a snapshot of a time in my life that was honestly pretty sad despite the smile on my face.

skateparkmug.jpeg.caption: I still don't know what to think of this picture. I look kind of good and kind of mad but I wasn't — I was skating. Wearing my dead brother's Underoath shirt.

Solocamp.jpeg.caption: I went camping by myself, ate some mushrooms, and figured some stuff out. Wearing my dead brother's hat and unknowingly representing some strip club in Miami called 11.

towwiththeflow.jpeg.caption: When I tried roadside assistance out, one of my first tire plugs the inflator died and I learned the hard way not to let that happen. Had to finish this tire the hard way.

tree1.jpeg.caption: I had no idea how to climb this tree but it goes up and gives you a beautiful view of the Flatirons in Boulder.

treefort.jpeg.caption: Yes I built this tree fort and connected it to another fort with a zip line 200 feet across. It was epic until Hurricane Milton took it out.

treenet1.jpeg.caption: Taking a moment to pretend I can fly in a new tree net build we're working on.

treeswing.jpeg.caption: This is from a very long time ago — probably 2009. I went on an epic journey to California to see my Uncle Rick who is pretty special.

treeyoga.jpeg.caption: This tree was special to me for a number of reasons connected to my cat and my brother. But I always liked to do the splits way up in it.

wayout.jpeg.caption: If you look closely in the distance you will see a Colorado Kitty man in the wild.

willykiss.jpeg.caption: Willie is my baby boy and I love him so much. Him and his litter mate are my absolute emotional support entities. I hope everyone has an emotional support entity in their life.

forest-01-sequoia-sempervirens-mhnt.bot..caption: Coast redwood — the ancient ones remember everything.

forest-03-duke-forest-misty-morning-h.jp.caption: Duke Forest at dawn. Mist and silence.

forest-05-ancient-oak-trees-in-sherwood-.caption: Ancient oaks in Sherwood. Some things outlast everything we build.
